subject: Startups
title: LLC vs. C-Corp
description: A fast breakdown of LLC vs. C-Corp for builders.

hook.text: Most small businesses choose LLCs. Most VC-funded startups choose C-Corps. The choice shapes everything that follows.

buildup.text: LLCs offer pass-through taxation—profits are taxed once on the owners' returns.

discovery.text: C-Corps allow preferred stock, which VCs need. LLCs can't easily issue the types of shares investors require.

twist.text: C-Corps get taxed twice: corporate income tax plus personal tax on dividends.

climax.text: If you plan to raise venture capital, incorporate as a Delaware C-Corp. It's the default for a reason.

punchline.text: LLC for lifestyle businesses. C-Corp for venture-scale ones.

quiz.question: Why do VC-funded startups choose C-Corps over LLCs?
options: C-Corps can issue preferred stock for investors
